lines: Learn in the UK, lead at home, shape the world.
Open for applications until 6 October 2026, at 11:00 (UTC)
Chevening is the UK Government’s prestigious international scholarships programme.
Funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office, and
, we offer exceptional future leaders the opportunity to further their education in the UK, so that they can drive impact in areas of shared priority for the UK and their home countries.
At a time of unprecedented global challenges, the Chevening network offers a real cause for hope. Our community of leaders and decision-makers is already making
in areas like climate action, economic prosperity, and conflict recovery.
Ready to turn your ambitions and experiences into lasting change?

How one Chevening scholar is using AI to make education more accessible

Growing up in Bihar, India, Anas Khan saw how unequal access to education could affect people’s futures. Today, as a Chevening scholar, he's exploring how AI can support students and teachers around the world. We find out more.
How a Chevening scholar is developing sustainable solutions for climate resilience

A Chevening Scholarship can help future leaders turn lived experience into scalable climate solutions. Discover how Janarthanan Venkatachalam is developing sustainable cooling technologies to address rising heat stress in vulnerable communities.
Strengthening India's nutrition security with a Chevening Scholarship

Niharikaa Naresh is using the knowledge and networks she's gaining at the University of Warwick to strengthen national nutrition policy in rural India, improving both the health and livelihoods of people in rural communities. We find out more.
Chevening Awards are supported by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and partner organisations.
